summary: Verified fix for /order 'إنشاء حساب' button. Backend endpoint /api/public/customer/register-request works correctly (5/5 pytest cases pass) and frontend now calls the correct path. E2E on mobile viewport 375x800: unique registration succeeds with success toast + dialog closes; duplicate phone (777777777) shows exact Arabic error 'رقم الهاتف مرتبط بحساب عميل آخر.'. Old /register path returns 404 as expected. No requests observed to the old path.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: RegisterForm success path always opens WhatsApp via openWhatsApp(ADMIN_WHATSAPP,...) even though backend already creates a notification – acceptable if intentional; otherwise could double-notify.
Consider adding aria-describedby to DialogContent to fix a11y console warnings.
seed_data_creation: Each success test creates a register_request row in DB (phone starts with 9 + unique digits, name prefix 'عميل اختبار TEST' or 'REG_<ts>'). Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint POST /api/public/customer/register-request is stable. Frontend RegisterForm in /app/frontend/src/pages/PublicOrder.jsx line 348 correctly calls the new path. Both cases 5 & 6 verified via Playwright with network capture confirming URL and toast text.
rca of the issue: Root cause was mismatched path between frontend (/public/customer/register) and backend (/public/customer/register-request). Fix in PublicOrder.jsx:348 aligned frontend to backend. Verified by network capture showing correct URL and both success + duplicate-phone toasts.
